# Ian Ramy - Technical Profile Digest

> [Ian Ramy](https://ianramy.co.ke) is the online handle for Ian Mwagore,
> a multi-disciplinary technologist operating at the intersection of Software Engineering, Data Science,
> and Cyber Security. He designs and ships scalable, production-grade software, extracts actionable
> intelligence from large and messy datasets, and hardens systems with zero-trust security
> principles. He is the creator & sole maintainer of Rustywoof and Co-Founder & CTO of Mwangalabs.

## About

Ian Ramy builds full-stack applications and data-driven systems with an
emphasis on performance, correctness, and security-by-design. His work spans
three disciplines that most engineers treat separately — application
development, applied machine learning, and defensive security — which he
combines into a single engineering practice: software that is fast, insightful,
and hard to compromise.

## Core Expertise

- **Software Engineering**: TypeScript, Rust — building scalable web
  applications and systems-level tooling.
- **Data Science**: Python, Machine Learning — turning raw and unstructured
  data into actionable, decision-ready intelligence.
- **Cyber Security**: Threat Detection, SIEM, zero-trust architecture —
  securing systems at the network, application, and data layer.

## Featured Project: Rustywoof

Rustywoof is Ian Ramy's flagship open-source project, built and maintained
entirely by him. It is a high-performance, memory-safe command-line secret
scanner and supply-chain defense tool, written in Rust, that detects exposed
cryptographic credentials, leaked API keys, and vulnerable or compromised
dependencies before they reach production.

- Repository: [Rustywoof on GitHub](https://github.com/ianramy/rustywoof)
- Status: Actively maintained, sole maintainer
- Package Registries:
  - [crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/rustywoof) (Rust)
  - [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ianramy/rustywoof) (Node.js)
  - [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/rustywoof/) (Python)

## Notable Client & Contract Work

- **Resonance Medical Company Limited**: Ian Ramy designed and built the
  company website for Resonance Medical Co. Limited (RMCL), a medical
  equipment distribution and precision engineering company operating across
  East and Central Africa.
  - Site: [resonancemedical.co.ke](https://resonancemedical.co.ke)

## Philosophy

Ian approaches engineering problems holistically: every system he builds is
evaluated not just for what it does, but for what data it exposes and what
attack surface it creates. This "build, analyze, secure" mindset informs his
approach to both client work and personal projects like Rustywoof.
